description: Maven plugin that invokes ModuleGraphClassifier to produce a curated --module-path / --class-path argfile for maven-compiler-plugin and maven-surefire-plugin. Closes the gap between spin's runtime classifier and the Maven build-time classifier so modular tests can run against dependency closures that contain split packages (e.g. Maven Core's maven-settings / maven-support overlap on org.apache.maven.settings.v4).
